verdict.rationale: Basecamp's evidence covers inviting external AI agents into projects and connecting ChatGPT or Claude through MCP, Skills and a CLI. Nothing shows an in-product builder for creating or configuring a custom agent. Those integrations are adjacent building blocks that let outside agents interact with Basecamp, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
